title: Moodboard for Resort 27 capsule
description: Compile fabric swatches, color stories, and reference imagery for the resort capsule kickoff with design and merchandising.

title: Source organic cotton jersey mills
description: Shortlist three mills that can supply GOTS-certified jersey in ivory, black, and soft sage for the basics program.

title: Tech pack: draped satin slip dress
description: Finalize graded measurements, construction notes, and trim callouts for the bias-cut satin slip before sampling.

title: Fit session for tailored wool blazer
description: Schedule sample fitting with the house model and document shoulder, lapel, and sleeve revisions for the second proto.

title: Update line sheet for wholesale market
description: Refresh SKUs, wholesale prices, and delivery windows for the upcoming market appointments with specialty retailers.

title: Approve embroidery artwork for evening set
description: Review digital embroidery placements on the bodice and sleeve of the evening co-ord and send signed-off files to the atelier.

title: Costing sheet for leather trench
description: Build full BOM costing including leather panels, lining, hardware, and labor so merchandising can set the retail target.

title: Photo lookbook shot list
description: Define looks, model lineup, and prop notes for the studio lookbook shoot covering daywear and evening heroes.

title: Select hardware for handbag capsule
description: Choose clasp, zipper pull, and foot finishes that match the metal tone across the mini and tote silhouettes.

title: Pattern correction: wide-leg trouser rise
description: Adjust front and back rise after fit comments; update nested patterns and re-cut the muslin for confirmation.

title: Care label copy for knitwear
description: Draft fiber content, wash, and dry-clean instructions that meet labeling requirements for the cashmere blend knits.

title: Vendor follow-up on silk georgette delay
description: Confirm revised ship date for the printed georgette and assess impact on sample room deadlines.

title: Sketch variants for bridal party jumpsuit
description: Explore three neckline and sash options while keeping the fluid wide leg; prepare flats for client review.

title: QC checklist for production samples
description: Define stitch quality, measurement tolerance, and pressing standards for the factory PP sample review.

title: Sustainability story for website PDP
description: Write short product-page copy covering regenerative wool and low-impact dyes for the outerwear drop.

title: Book atelier overtime for show pieces
description: Confirm weekend hours and headcount needed to finish hand-finished runway looks before the show call.

title: Colorway approval: spring print family
description: Review strike-offs for the botanical print in clay, ink, and porcelain; mark approved colorways for bulk.

title: Size run plan for denim program
description: Propose size curve and ratio for the high-rise straight jean based on last season sell-through.

title: Accessory pairing guide for stylists
description: Map belts, scarves, and footwear to key ready-to-wear looks for wholesale showroom styling.

title: Archive digitization: past season patterns
description: Scan and file last three seasons of master patterns with naming conventions for the design archive.
